target_customer: B2B startups and sales teams that want outbound leads across LinkedIn, email and X
problem: Founders and small sales teams struggle to find buyers who are actively looking and to run multichannel outreach without stitching several tools together.
business_model: Subscription from $75 per month per LinkedIn account plus done-for-you plans ($1,740 setup, $2,980 to $5,640 per month)
product_category: AI outbound sales and lead engagement

founders.name: Namanyay Goel
previous_startups: Gigacatalyst (YC-listed, same Giga Next umbrella per one aggregator)
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he has coded since age 13 and shares AI engineering lessons with 4M+ blog readers. YC page lists only one founder though team size is 5.

competitors.name: Expandi
competitors.traction_then: listed as the reference product in many 2026 alternative lists

competitors.name: HeyReach
competitors.what: LinkedIn outreach for agencies running many accounts, about $79 per month

competitors.name: Apollo.io
competitors.what: Contact database plus email sequencing with lighter LinkedIn automation

competitors.name: Clay
competitors.what: Data enrichment and personalization workflows feeding other senders

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting accounts, sequencing and AI reply drafting are standard; the 2 billion contact database is likely sourced from data vendors. No proprietary research is needed.

defensibility.rationale: Many LinkedIn and email outreach tools exist and the product is built on commodity data and LLMs; LinkedIn platform rules are a dependency risk.

market_need_then: Founder-led outbound is a widespread need; the product grew out of the internal system the founder used to acquire customers for his other company, per one aggregator.

branding.domain_note: Uses pumpgtm.com; no purchase story found.

identity.visual_style: Landing page with testimonials, trusted-by logo wall and comparison table
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, benefit-focused, personal founder-led tone with transparent pricing and a meeting guarantee.

branding.brand_signature: Meeting guarantee: first-month base fee returned if no qualified meeting is booked
branding.community_and_virality: Site quotes other YC founders as customers; no independent community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is a GTM-jargon compound that collides with Pump (cloud cost) and Pump.fun in search; no independent brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: PumpGTM is a Spring 2026 YC company that productized the outbound system its founder used for another startup. It is too early for an outcome. The market is crowded with LinkedIn and email outreach tools, so it must win on results and the done-for-you offer rather than technology.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with a $500-750k enterprise value; it is a single aggregator entry that matches the YC standard deal and is not recorded as a round. Competitor sources are 2026 comparison pages dated at the batch; direct competitors existed earlier. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs.
